tasks.Find_x_intercept: Calculate the x-intercept (a) of the line given by the equation \(\frac{x}{4} + \frac{y}{12} = 1\).
tasks.Find_y_intercept: Calculate the y-intercept (b) of the line given by the equation \(\frac{x}{4} + \frac{y}{12} = 1\).
tasks.Solve_for_slope: Determine the slope (m) of the line from the given equation.
tasks.Sum_intercepts_and_slope: Calculate the value of a + b + m.
